creative_direction.name: Sonar Ping Chart Monument
creative_direction.brief: Cool Water as a single ping on a nautical chart: a flat matte glacier-mint card carries fine concentric sonar rings in deep marine teal expanding from the exact centre of the frame, one thicker hard-edge ring marking the return echo. The upright blue slab stands centred in the lower two-thirds as the source of the ping, its baked backlight glow untouched by the flat ink world. All type stacks in a calm centred monument band at the top: wide-tracked Bodoni brand line, the name in one generous Didone line, the eau de toilette line closing the stack, with a short teal rule floating beneath like a chart tick. No floor, no horizon - pure radial echo geometry against translucent ocean glass.
creative_direction.material: flat matte screen-printed chart paper with concentric sonar rings
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
